name: 1 Apr 1968

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2469 (Alteration of boundary of Urban County District of Newtownabbey (confirmation of Antrim County Council order of 12 Dec 1967))
references.note: 1 Mar 1968, page 70. Made 6 Feb 1968. In force: 15 Feb 1968 (electoral); 1 Apr 1968 (all other purposes). Confirms the county council order altering Newtownabbey UD (areas transferred both to and from Antrim RD).

references.label: Newtownards Borough (Alteration) Order (Northern Ireland) 1968 (S.R. & O. 1968 No. 23)
references.note: Made by the Ministry of Development under Articles 25 and 27 of the Schedule to the Local Government (Application of Enactments) Order 1898 and affirmed by both Houses; notice in Belfast Gazette issue 2468, 23 Feb 1968, page 62. Alters the boundary of the Borough of Newtownards, with consequential adjustments to North Down Rural District; appointed day 1 Apr 1968.

references.label: Census of Population 1971: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas, Co. Antrim (1) and Co. Down (3) (1 Apr 1968).

references.label: Urban Districts Boundaries (Procedure) Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 170)
references.note: Made 9 Dec 1936 by the Ministry of Home Affairs under section 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934: the local inquiry and public notices required before a county council could make an order altering or defining the boundary of an urban county district. The Newtownabbey boundary order confirmed in 1968 recites compliance with it (Belfast Gazette, issue 2469, 1 Mar 1968).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 2469 (Newtownabbey Urban District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 26 Feb 1968, page 71. Made 12 Dec 1967. In force: 1 Apr 1968. District boundary altered: -1962, and the Urban Districts Boundaries (procedure) Order, 1936; places named: Newtownabbey Urban District, Antrim Rural District, Belfast, County Antrim; by Ministry of Development / Antrim County Council; made 12 December 1967; in force 1 April 1968; inquiry 25 April 1967.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Armagh urban district boundary are traced from the map deposited with the 1946 Order (about 20 m); parts of the Bangor borough boundary are taken from the map of the 1966 Order, registered on the OSNI six-inch Edition 5 sheets (about 20 m); parts of the Larne borough boundary are traced from the 1956 extension map (about 25 m). They are drawn dotted on the map.
